rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for saying that anything is acceptable or that someone may do anything that works.

example.english: You can eat whatever you want.
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 sik6 mat1 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when “whatever” dismisses the particular choice or circumstances, as in “whatever your choice.”

example.english: Whatever you choose, I support you.
example.jyutping: mou4 leon6 dim2 gaan2 ngo5 dou1 zi1 ci4 nei5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual construction for “any N at all” or “whatever kind of N.”

example.english: Whatever style is fine; choose for yourself.
example.traditional: 乜嘢款式都得，你自己揀啦。
example.jyutping: mat1 je5 fun2 sik1 dou1 dak1 nei5 zi6 gei2 gaan2 laa1

rows.note: Use this for the “no matter what happens or how” sense, usually in a clause such as 無論點都……

example.english: Whatever happens, we have to give it a try.
example.jyutping: mou4 leon6 dim2 dou1 jiu3 si3 haa5

rows.jyutping: mou4 leon6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 gei2 daai6 doi6 gaa3
rows.note: Use this fixed phrase specifically for “whatever the cost,” meaning regardless of how great a price must be paid.

example.english: Whatever the cost, I have to save him.
example.traditional: 無論要付出幾大代價，我都要救返佢。
example.jyutping: mou4 leon6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 gei2 daai6 doi6 gaa3 ngo5 dou1 jiu3 gau3 faan1 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when “whatever” means that the speaker does not care which option is chosen.
